messages:
maggie: quick PM follow-up: from the weekend latency incident. proposes 3 small runbook changes: (A) explicit escalation SLA (oncall -> runtime lead in 20m), (B) a compact triage checklist, (C) a PM "pattern-match" flag to route repeats to Pattern Board.
devon: +1. checklist should include model-variant fallback check and prefix/KV cache stats.
anya: for automation I'll need exact CLI checks. suggest copy-paste commands (safe):
redwoodctl cache stats --namespace=inference --prefix=kv --json
redwoodctl model get-config --model=redwood-alpha --show-fallbacks
kubectl -n inference describe hpa inference-hpa
curl -sS -w "%{time_total}" -o /dev/null https://inference.svc/healthz
samir: owners/timelines: devon -> runbook PR in 48h, anya -> test harness in 5d, rachel -> update PM template + pattern routing in 24h. I'll create tracking ticket and verify closures.
rachel: escalation detail: add after-hours SMS step and contact table in runbook. also include a DANGER callout for `cache flush` with confirm flag.
maggie: small addition: triage checklist step to record whether incident matches known patterns (cache thrash / autoscaler oversubscribe / tokenization edgecase). if matched, auto-tag PM and schedule RCA.
ops-bot: Created INCIDENT-6022 "Runbook: triage checklist + escalation SLA + pattern-flag" assigned to samir, due 2026-05-10.
maggie: thanks all  owners & deadlines above. posting checklist to incidents board and closing thread unless blockers.
